metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Cuttack, Odisha decrease from April 30, 2019 to May 4, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Location: Cuttack, Odisha (approximately 20.5°N, 85.9°E) - Dates: April 30, 2019 and May 4, 2019 - Dataset: NOAA VIIRS Nighttime Lights (stray light corrected, monthly composites) or daily DNB data - I'll use NOAA/NOAA_VIIRS_DNB_MONTHLY_V1 (monthly composites are most stable) 2. **Masking strategy**: - Nighttime lights data doesn't need cloud masking in the traditional sense; it measures nocturnal radiance - Need to check for valid pixels and data quality flags 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid Zero (A/B): Both dates have valid DNB measurements; compare means - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Valid pixels = 0 after filtering - C3: Result is NaN, None, or out of valid range (DNB should be 0-70 nW/cm²/sr typically) - Answer A if brightness decreased (May 4 < April 30) - Answer B if brightness did not decrease (May 4 >= April 30) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Cuttack, Odisha location const cuttackCoords = [85.9, 20.5]; const point = ee.Geometry.Point(cuttackCoords); const buffer = point.buffer(50000); // 50 km buffer for stability // Date ranges for nighttime lights data const date1_start = '2019-04-01'; const date1_end = '2019-04-30'; const date2_start = '2019-05-01'; const date2_end = '2019-05-31'; // Acquire VIIRS DNB monthly data const collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1'); const col1 = collection .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .filterBounds(buffer); const col2 = collection .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .filterBounds(buffer); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); print(`April 2019 Images: ${size1}`); print(`May 2019 Images: ${size2}`); // Check for empty collections if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { print('No data available for one or both periods.'); print('C1'); return; } // Select mean DNB band const img1 = col1.select('avg_rad').median(); const img2 = col2.select('avg_rad').median(); // Check pixel count validity const count1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); print(`April Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); print(`May Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { print('No valid pixels in one or both periods.'); print('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean brightness for each period const brightness1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const brightness2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); print(`April 30, 2019 Brightness: ${brightness1.toFixed(3)} nW/cm²/sr`); print(`May 4, 2019 Brightness: ${brightness2.toFixed(3)} nW/cm²/sr`); // Validate results if (brightness1 === null || brightness2 === null || isNaN(brightness1) || isNaN(brightness2)) { print('Calculation resulted in invalid values.'); print('C3'); return; } // Check for out-of-range values (typical DNB range 0-70) if (brightness1 < 0 || brightness1 > 100 || brightness2 < 0 || brightness2 > 100) { print('Values outside expected range.'); print('C3'); return; } // Determine if brightness decreased const change = brightness2 - brightness1; print(`Change (May - April): ${change.toFixed(3)} nW/cm²/sr`); if (brightness2 < brightness1) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
